text_block_list.text: Lunchtime. When I went to the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with that mountain of croquettes...?!
choice_data_list: Is someone having a competitive eating contest...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Come on, Turbo-san.
We're just getting started eating!
choice_data_list: Wait, Ikuno?! What are you doing?!
Wait, Ikuno?! What are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! This is, ta-da, Operation 'Buffed-Up Meals'!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eat a ton! Get all buff and pumped up!!
And wiiiin the race—!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? It's a very reasonable policy.
Physical conditioning is vital for athletes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Controlling body shape after calorie intake.
It is also perfect for honing that skill.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, Ikuno!
We're still gonna keep eating~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh...
My tummy... feels like it's gonna burst...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am too... but... we're still just under 70% of what's planned!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I quit here, I'll end up stopping at "buff"
instead of getting "super-buff"...!
choice_data_list: Let's eat up and get buff!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I will follow Trainer's instructions.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"However...
stopping Turbo-san when she's trying so hard..."
choice_data_list: Turbo, if you push yourself too hard, you won't even be able to run.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gaaah...! That's so true...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But... then what should Turbo do?
I really want to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Adjusting things as needed to best fit the client's needs
is the true art of planning...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me, Turbo-san.
In that case, a reasonable mid-to-long term plan...
I shall draft Operation Muscular Meals Phase 2!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Be that as it may, leaving leftovers is strictly forbidden.
Let us pack it up to take home so everyone can enjoy it together."
And so, Operation Muscle Meal was changed to a more reasonable approach.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mm... I'm gonna become Muscle Turbo...!
I can... keep going~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's the spirit! I'll do my best alongside you. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Leaving leftovers behind just isn't right...!

After that, Ikuno Dictus and Twin Turbo
managed to finish every last bite of the muscle-building meal.
